InstrumentSchema.description: Canonical schema marker for persisted instrument envelopes.

ListedFutureSettlement.description: Final settlement mode for a listed future.

oneOf.description: Cash settlement of final variation margin.
Delivery of a standardized quantity of an identified asset.

asset.description: Deliverable asset, grade, location, or basket identifier.

quantity_per_contract.description: Physical units delivered per exchange contract.

ListedFutureTerms.description: Standardized position, multiplier, and lifecycle terms for a listed future.

contracts.description:
Number of exchange contracts. Fractional values are permitted for
portfolio aggregation but must be finite and strictly positive.

currency.description: Currency in which variation margin is paid.

entry_price.description: Trade fill price in the same price-point units as the market mark.

last_trading_date.description: Final date on which the contract trades.

multiplier.description: Settlement-currency value of one full price point per contract.

quoted_price.description: Optional live exchange mark, in price points.

settlement.description: Cash or physical final settlement convention.

settlement_date.description: Date on which final cash settlement is completed.

settlement_price.description: Optional official final settlement price, in price points.

Position.description: Position direction for futures and forwards.

attributes.description: Attributes for scenario selection and tagging

discount_curve_id.description:
Discount curve identifier. **Unused in PV**: the future is daily
margined so the mark-to-market is undiscounted, and no Dv01 is
registered. Retained for market-data identification/scenario plumbing.

terms.description:
Standard listed position and lifecycle terms. `terms.multiplier` is the
settlement-currency value of one index point ($1,000 for CBOE VIX),
`terms.entry_price` is the trade price in index points and
`terms.settlement_date` is the SOQ date on which the final settlement
price is fixed.
